## What it does

**GENERATED by `src/UndeadCreaturesReplacerEGO/tools/01-forward-ucr-visuals.py` — never hand-edit `Npcs/`.** Kolapon's `Undead Creatures Replacer.esp` (UCR, load 175 in Alpha 0.5) masters only Skyrim/Update/FS but overrides 44 Lost One / Ahnengeist NPCs, 36 also overridden by EGO (39) — each UCR record is FS's/base Enderal's plus its new race and skin, so it silently reverted EGO's stats, perks and inventories on all of them. Visible symptom (2026-10-07): Zu-Sherath `04459F` dropped FS's `Spell Tome: Chaosnova (Rank I)` `02F2A1` again, whose spell `02F297` EGO retired with the description *"This spell is no longer used in the 'Gameplay Overhaul'"* (EGO's Chaos Nova Rank I is the old Rank III tome `02F2A3`). 38 overrides = previous winner verbatim (EGO; FS for three trigger NPCs — until 2026-10-14 `EGO SE - Leveling Redone` for Miskahmur `1401A4`; LR left the list, so EGO's record is the base there too and Miskahmur carries `_00E_LehrbuchSneakTo50 08591E` again, which LR had stripped) + UCR's FORWARD fields (Race, WornArmor, Height, AttackRace/Attacks, Template unlinking + its TemplateFlags, Name, the `Female` flag). UCR's stale non-visual changes are DROPPED: ActorTypeBoss `090CA9` stripped from 4 bosses, package `006BAA:FS` from the trigger NPCs, AIData warn radii, and boss template `090BAF`'s Class. The script fails on any unclassified UCR field change. UCR's deletion of NPC `02F518` (and its only two refs in Vyn cell `001D71`) is left alone. Winner chain from a binary scan of every Alpha 0.5 plugin; UCR won every record. Masters: Skyrim + FS + EGO + UCR (forces load-after). Built and deployed 2026-10-07, not yet verified in game; the tome fix reaches only an un-looted Zu-Sherath (new game).
